about_short_description.short_description: Ahli Bank is an financial services firm that offers services like corporate & retail banking, private banking, treasury and investments.

product.name: Corporate Banking Financing Solutions
product.description: Provides various financing options including working capital, contractor, medium and long-term loans, equipment and fleet finance, real estate finance, project finance, syndicated loans, and structured finance.

product.name: Merchant Payment Solutions (Ahlipay)
product.description: A payment processing service for businesses to accept and manage merchant payments.

product.name: Operating and Deposit Accounts
product.description: Includes current accounts, call accounts, and term deposits for individuals and businesses to manage and save funds.

product.name: Wages Protection System (WPS)
product.description: A payroll service compliant with Qatar’s Wages Protection System regulations to ensure timely salary payments and regulatory monitoring.

product.name: Cards
product.description: Various card products including payroll cards, corporate deposit cards, credit cards, debit cards, and prepaid cards for personal and business use.

product.name: Corporate Online Banking
product.description: An online platform for corporate clients to manage accounts, payments, and banking services digitally.
